title: 36 Hours in Nashville
abstract: Music City is amped for a comeback, driven by local creativity, entrepreneurship and a D.I.Y. attitude.

title: 36 Hours in Nashville
abstract: Sure, you can still tap your feet to a country beat in Music City, but keep exploring and you’ll find everything from enticing shops to a dynamic food scene.

title: 36 Hours in Cartagena
abstract: Lining the ancient walls of Cartagena, Colombia, travelers find traditional food, beautiful beaches and a nightlife that heats up long after the sun goes down.

title: 36 Hours in Cartagena, Colombia
abstract: From Old City strolls and sunset views to fried street snacks and late-night dancing, spend a weekend in this Caribbean city.

title: 36 Hours in Central Park, New York
abstract: With its endless trails, hidden nooks, museums and nearby night spots, Central Park is that rare tourist destination that is also a pleasure ground for locals.

title: 36 Hours: Central Park, New York
abstract: Spot birds and gaze at stars, explore gardens and go for a row, snack on a roof and sway to some jazz during a weekend in the city’s sanctuary.

title: 36 Hours in Florence, Italy
abstract: Known for its rich history, Florence is a destination for those seeking vibrant culinary, artistic and musical experiences.

title: 36 Hours in Florence, Italy
abstract: See the skyline without battling crowds, sample pastries from a secret gem, sip artisanal beers and soak up culture during a weekend in the Tuscan capital.
